```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(bio3d)
library(dplyr)
```

In the Structure Assessment tab of your project in SWISS-MODEL, download the associated file under QMEANDisCo. The file downloaded will be a PDB file that we will read in here to evaluate the local QMEAN score for each amino acid of the homologoy modeled chinook SERT.
- resno: Residue number
- resid: Amino acid identity
- b: Local quality score stored in the B-factor field

```{r}

# Replace with the actual filename
pdb_XP_042153127.1 <- read.pdb("../data/XP_042153127.1_chinook_sert_qmean.pdb")

pdb_XP_042151898.1 <- read.pdb("../data/XP_042151898.1_chinook_sert_qmean.pdb")

# Extract local quality scores
local_scores_XP_042153127.1 <- pdb_XP_042153127.1$atom %>%
  filter(elety == "CA") %>%
  select(resno, resid, b)


local_scores_XP_042151898.1 <- pdb_XP_042151898.1$atom %>%
  filter(elety == "CA") %>%
  select(resno, resid, b)

View(local_scores_XP_042153127.1)
View(local_scores_XP_042151898.1)
```

```{r}

#  SERT S1 binding-site residue numbers (in chinook sequence)
s1_positions <- c(
  109, 112, 186, 190, 191,
  350, 351, 356, 453, 454, 512
)

# Extract local quality scores for S1 binding-site
s1_quality_XP_042153127.1 <- local_scores_XP_042153127.1 %>%
  filter(resno %in% s1_positions) %>%
  arrange(resno)

s1_quality_XP_042151898.1 <- local_scores_XP_042151898.1 %>%
  filter(resno %in% s1_positions) %>%
  arrange(resno)

print(s1_quality_XP_042153127.1)
print(s1_quality_XP_042151898.1)
```

Generally, scores closer to 1 indicate higher predicted local structural quality. Scores below approximately 0.6 warrant closer inspection. 

*Our results support the structural plausibility of the XP_042151898.1 and XP_042153127.1 modeled Chinook SERT binding pocket with local scores that indicate that the modeled environments around these residues are predicted to have good structural accuracy.*

Although these local scores at the S1 central binding-site indicate good estimated structural reliability they do not confirm binding-pocket accuracy. *Next steps involve protein preperation and confirmation that the modeled binding-site can accomodate known SERT inhibitors.*
